fisher.QNM: Pinned 440 cubic spline, no extrapolation; CODATA2018_IAU2015; beta=alpha_CODATA2018*sqrt(e) runtime
fisher.amplitude_phase: Marginalized with Schur complement in analytical causal damped-mode Fourier Fisher
fisher.mass_spin: Fixed; no claim to remove single-mode free-M/chi degeneracy
fisher.snr_transport: Two INPUT routes: equal isolated rho440 per PSD compares shapes; same reference source with amplitude A=rho440_O4_INPUT/||h||_O4 propagates rho440_PSD=rho440_O4_INPUT*||h||_PSD/||h||_O4. No network IMR conversion.
fisher.counts: N50=25/z_local^2 [INPUT E(Z)=5]; N90conditional=(5+1.2815515655446004)^2/z_local^2 for known unit-variance one-sided Gaussian Z. Neither is calibrated significance or realistic yield. Zero or |delta|<1e-12 => null operational targets with OPEN reason.
fisher.same_source_detector_gain: Computed future from analytical GR440 norm in each reference PSD, fixed source and amplitude across PSDs
fisher.R_PROP_and_COHERENT: Explicit OPEN rows, no universal exponential rate; R-GLOBAL zero by construction

posterior.label: pSEOBNRv5PHM
posterior.mass_frame: final_mass_non_evolved detector frame, as audited C4; redshift retained sample by sample

prior_strings.domega220: Uniform(minimum=-0.8, maximum=2.0, name='domega220', latex_label='domega220', unit=None, boundary=None)
prior_strings.dtau220: Uniform(minimum=-0.8, maximum=2.0, name='dtau220', latex_label='dtau220', unit=None, boundary=None)

estimators: Paired-residual 2D Scott KDE with three bandwidths, full sample
Independent 2D Gaussian full moments, no KDE bandwidth
posterior.estimand: log p_residual(0)-log p_free_sector(0); same paired sample, other mode marginalized identically
posterior.range_scope: Estimator sensitivity, not CI or frequentist coverage. Gaussian moments do not solve hard-prior boundaries.
posterior.boundaries: Report marginal quantiles, edge fractions and unbounded KDE mass outside each original prior; no silent boundary renormalization.
posterior.global_prior_and_nuisance_normalization: OPEN; uniform tested-coordinate ratio=1 does not by itself prove global evidence contract
posterior.double_count: Do not multiply 220 and 440 marginal diagnostics from the same event
posterior.sample_selection: All 40776 paired draws; no thinning, seed, bandwidth selection or sample filtering

fixed_free_robustness.available: GW250114 single archived pSEOBNRv5PHM posterior with both 220 and 440 free; 32/33 catalog products fix higher-mode deviations in other events
not_comparable: Different events do not isolate the fixed/free440 effect
Conditioning the free440 posterior near zero is not an independent fixed440 recovery
The one LVK injection compares injected mode content, while both recovery products have free440
fixed_free_robustness.new_PE_required_for_matched_fixed_free: OPEN; no such PE authorized here

E4.output_scope: All ten readings and both physical variants in forecasts. 220 and 440 sector diagnostics explicitly separate. Joint220+440 evidence and matched fixed/free comparison remain OPEN when unsupported.

models.name: BROWNIAN_PHASE
models.limitation: White frequency noise has no finite pointwise frequency variance; finite-window estimator transfer required

models.name: CAUCHY_PHASE
models.law: Symmetric stable increments with scale Gamma*dt; same first-harmonic ensemble decay
models.limitation: No finite increment variance; cannot reuse Gaussian sigma_pop or Brownian transfer

models.name: POISSON_COHERENT_OCCUPATION
models.limitation: Poisson is occupation weights here, not a Poisson time-jump process. N/amplitude mapping and fitting window OPEN; not single exponential

models.name: COMPOUND_POISSON_TIME_JUMPS
models.law: Characteristic exponent lambda*(E exp(iJ)-1) if chosen
models.limitation: Jump law/intensity and estimator transfer not supplied; no sigma or event rate assigned

models.name: DETERMINISTIC_ENSEMBLE
models.limitation: Zero intrinsic jitter in this deterministic model does not imply zero recovered scatter or bias

statistic.name: HETEROSCEDASTIC_GAUSSIAN_PROFILE_LRT_SYNTHETIC_INPUT
statistic.null: q=0 i.e. sigma_pop=sigma_sys; not null total width zero unless sigma_sys=0 lower-bound scenario
statistic.alternative: q>0; common mean mu profiled under both hypotheses
statistic.calibration: Separate heterogeneous route-IV null using registered real sigma_i and empirical tail/upper limit; not scalar matched-filter null
statistic.odds_not_LRT: Bayes odds additionally require model/prior normalization; no equivalence assumed

full_posterior.observable: sigma_pop of delta_f220, all full paired posterior samples, never population of medians
full_posterior.uniform_prior: pi_i=1/W_i; factor W_i retained per event. Ratio=1 only where identical constant tested priors cancel in a specified comparison.
full_posterior.global_contract: OPEN nuisance-prior compatibility, complete support, selection alpha(Lambda) and calibration; not a calibrated hierarchical likelihood
full_posterior.point_null: sigma_pop=0 is not approximated by a silently chosen small Gaussian; needs separately registered density/delta-null method
full_posterior.execution: Utility prepared; no full-posterior population fit in this package; principal owns nuisance

information.formula: I(q=0)=0.5*sum_i(sigma_i^2+sigma_sys^2)^(-2) in Gaussian model; relative weight=1/sigma_i^4 only when sigma_sys=0
information.known_mean_scope: Local expected information; fitted-mean finite-N effects and tails need calibration
information.sigma_input: Archived full posterior std_ddof1 of df, a planning proxy for measurement error
information.no_double_weight: Do not multiply an already heteroscedastic log likelihood by sigma^-4 again
information.sample_policy: All E0.3 eligible events; no posterior-width cut. Archived31/33/10/18 are calibration scenarios, not E2 test selection.

secondary.statistic: Fraction |delta_f_hat_i-mu_hat|>3*sigma_i; report uncentered |delta_f_hat_i|>3*sigma_i alongside as order wording
secondary.center: Profile common mean; its fit and estimator must also be reproduced under null
secondary.event_estimator: Posterior mean proposed diagnostic; not substitute for primary full-posterior inference
secondary.interpretation: Sensitivity to heavy tails/jumps, not unique evidence of Poisson/Cauchy law
secondary.multiplicity: Secondary only; separately calibrated after fixed selection, with false-alarm allocation decided in E2; no sigma claim

jitter_transfer.needed: Brownian injections through registered recovery pipeline, finite window, source convention and seeds; future E3 owner, not executed here

sigma_sys.needed: GR two-family calibration in delta_f channel; C5 a/dtau bias is not delta_f sigma_sys
